notes: Capability registry used by the Oscillator. Scores are OSSA Studio evaluation scores for architectural fidelity (geometry preservation, mask adherence, material accuracy), not release dates. Administrators can edit this registry in Settings > Oscillator; edits are saved to the data directory and override this file. A model is only selectable when it is listed here AND discovered through the provider's model-listing API with the configured credentials. Cost figures are planning estimates and must be checked against the provider's current price list.
